description:
• About our brand and products:
HaloPlasma blends cutting-edge plasma physics with art and design. Our flagship pieces include:

  • Lumora: hand-filled noble-gas tubes that glow with distinct spectral colors.
  • Plasma Toroid (Plasma Ring): a mesmerizing, self-organizing plasma ring generator with optional music-reactive editions.
    We design for curiosity, education, and immersive aesthetics—loved by science enthusiasts, makers, educators, and creators.

• What makes us different:

  • Authentic plasma, not LEDs: real noble gases and high-voltage plasma effects with true emission colors.
  • Artist-engineered: fusion of lab-grade components and gallery-level presentation.
  • Educational impact: perfect for classrooms, demos, and STEM outreach.
  • Crafted quality: iterative R&D, upgraded drivers, and strict QC for stable, vivid glow.
  • Shareable wow-factor: highly viral visuals that perform strongly on short-video platforms.

• How affiliates can earn:

  • Commission: 12% per qualifying sale driven through your unique link or code.
  • Cookie window: 30 days attribution (last-click via affiliate link or your code).
  • Payouts: monthly via PayPal (or alternative by request), with returns/cancellations auto-adjusted.
  • Bonuses: performance tiers and launch bonuses for top partners during new product drops.

• How to promote us:

  • Content ideas:
    • Unboxings, setup tutorials, and first-light reactions.
    • Side-by-side color/spectrum demos of different gases.
    • Slow-motion/macrophotography of plasma filaments and toroids.
    • Classroom or lab demos highlighting physics concepts (ionization, spectra, EM fields).
    • Ambient/ASMR lighting scenes and music-reactive showcases.
  • Best practices:
    • Use your unique link or discount code in captions, bios, and pinned comments.
    • Post in dark environments for maximum glow and contrast.
    • Include safety notes (high voltage, for demonstration use, adult supervision).
    • Tag @HaloPlasma and relevant hashtags (#plasma, #STEM, #scienceart).
    • Repurpose across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Twitter/X.
  • Assets:
    • We provide media kits (photos, b-roll, logos), product specs, and FAQs on request.

• Other information:

  • Regions and shipping: we ship internationally; check product pages for current availability and lead times.
  • Support: priority creator support via simonliu6046048@gmail.com for collabs, samples, and custom briefs.
  • Compliance: disclose affiliate relationships per FTC/EU guidelines; avoid misleading claims; follow local safety rules.
  • Brand fit: ideal audiences include science/education, maker/DIY, gadget/art decor, and experiential events.
  • Join the program: request your affiliate link or code via email, or sign up on haloplasma.com (Affiliate page). If you need a custom landing page or bundle, we can set it up.

If you’d like, I can tailor this copy for your site’s Affiliate page and provide a short creator outreach email template.
payout_period: 1st of each month or Quarterly on the 15th for payout timing
